name: In Her Charming Grasp
overview: Jiang Xian willingly clung to Lin Yuanzhou and became the city’s laughingstock. Everyone thought she would marry no one but him, until they realized she only treated him as a stand-in. She loved no one and even wanted to run away. Lin Yuanzhou, once incapable of love, gradually fell for her for real, and in the end, like a madman, bound her to his side and pleaded for her love.
